lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and ten visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like coordinate system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains multiple discrete, high-luminance blobs of smaller diameter relative to flank blobs, distributed primarily along the anterior and medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of irregular, high-intensity linear markings are visible on the upper dorsal flank, appearing as a jagged horizontal disruption of the primary spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small-diameter luminance maxima, distinct from the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the primary flank.
